purpose: Teach: 集結/論評/開館/取り込む/愛称/利率/換金/代弁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、全社員を集結させて方針を語られたぞ
lines.en: When your father founded the company, he gathered every employee to lay out his vision.
lines.style: Measured, almost ceremonial tone. Slight lift on the memory — pride beneath restraint. Patient pacing, as if recounting something sacred.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新聞の論評にも目を通された
lines.en: Yes. He kept up with the newspapers, even the editorials.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Steady respect in the voice — not performing humility, but genuine. Slight pause before speaking, choosing words with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社の開館式を盛大にされたぞ
lines.en: When he opened the headquarters, he made quite a celebration of it.
lines.style: Gentle reminiscence. Eyes distant with the warmth of old memory. Slow rhythm, lingering on the word 'celebration' like it still glows.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の声を経営に取り込む姿勢でした
lines.en: Yes. He believed in bringing the employees' voices into how the company was managed.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Warm conviction without preaching. He's defending his father's choices, not just stating them. Breath between thought and speech.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員のクラブに愛称を付けられたぞ
lines.en: He even gave nicknames to the staff clubs — made them his own somehow.
lines.style: Small smile in the voice. Wistful but lighter now — a personal touch breaking through formality. Slower on the recollection, almost wondering how he remembers it so clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは取引銀行と利率交渉に強かった
lines.en: Yes. And he had a real gift for negotiating interest rates with the banks.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. A shift — acknowledging the shrewdness, the practical skill beneath the sentiment. Still warm, but grounded. Not romanticizing, just honest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外送金の換金率を交渉されたぞ
lines.en: He knew how to drive hard bargains on currency exchange too — for the overseas transfers.
lines.style: Admiring but matter-of-fact. Less wistful here, more appreciative of the cunning. A slight nod in the voice, recognizing tactical intelligence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の苦労を株主に代弁されました
lines.en: Yes. He'd advocate for his employees to the shareholders — made sure their struggles were heard.
lines.style: Firm, almost quiet conviction. This is the lesson that mattered most. Slight deepening of tone — this wasn't just memory, it was inheritance. Closes with quiet certainty.
